title: [Issue]: after updating to 10.9.2 can't connect to the server anymore. AuthenticationScheme: CustomAuthentication was not authenticated.
body:

comments.author: participant1
comments.body: I have the same issue on Windows version, all LAN clients fail to connect, including the web version.

comments.author: reporter
comments.body:
My solution: disable IPv6 in `network.xml` config:
```
  <EnableIPv4>true</EnableIPv4>
  <EnableIPv6>false</EnableIPv6>
```

In this case it will bind to IPv4 ip:
```
[15:17:16] [DBG] [24] Jellyfin.Networking.Manager.NetworkManager: Bind Addresses ["0.0.0.0"]
```

comments.author: participant1
comments.body:
this is not an IPv6 issue, even with IPv4 only nothing works, also all my clients use ipv4 explicitly anyway.

to expand, I see nothing wrong in the logs, it binds successfully, and web version does load server select page, but fails when trying to connect (and I don't have any custom scheme auth errors in server logs fwiw).

comments.author: participant2
comments.body: Having the same issue here, explicitly disabling IPv6 in `network.xml` worked 🤷‍♂️

comments.author: participant1
comments.body:
My issue resolved after disabling virtual interface filtering in config
```xml
<IgnoreVirtualInterfaces>false</IgnoreVirtualInterfaces>
```
